# nop-resource

A Crossplane managed resource that goes Ready on a timer and creates nothing.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | string | `"nop"` | Name of the NopResource. |
| readyAfter | string | `"10s"` | How long the provider waits before reporting Ready.  Its poll interval is 10s, so anything finer is rounded up to one poll and a lab that asked for `1s` waits the same as one that asked for `10s`. Stated rather than defaulted low, so the readiness timeout below is visibly larger than this.  |

| resourceProvider | MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROVIDER | A provider is healthy and the resource kinds it defines can be applied. |
